properties.text: All HTTP requests on port 3000 must pass through bearer token authentication before reaching route handlers.
properties.assertion: forall req on port 3000: handler(req) => req.passed_auth_middleware == true

properties.text: SQL queries using discord_uid in member lookup must use parameterized statements, not string interpolation.
properties.assertion: forall query(discord_uid): query.uses_parameterized_binding(discord_uid) == true

properties.text: SQL queries using discord_uid in member-team resolution must use parameterized statements.
properties.assertion: forall query(discord_uid) in member_team_resolution: query.is_parameterized == true

properties.text: SQL queries using discord_uid in team leader check must use parameterized statements.
properties.assertion: forall query(discord_uid) in team_leader_check: query.is_parameterized == true

properties.text: Complete member info query with discord_uid must use parameterized binding to prevent SQL injection.
properties.assertion: forall query(discord_uid) in complete_member_info: query.is_parameterized == true

properties.text: Member data queries returning PII must require valid bearer token authorization before execution.
properties.assertion: forall query returning (supabase_auth_user_id|is_admin|student_number): caller.is_authenticated == true

properties.text: Complete member info aggregation exposing all PII fields must require authentication and authorization.
properties.assertion: forall complete_member_info(uid): caller.is_authenticated == true AND caller.is_authorized(uid) == true

properties.text: discord_role_id must not be exposed to unauthorized callers in team listing or generation role queries.
properties.assertion: forall response containing discord_role_id: response.caller.is_authenticated == true

properties.text: is_admin field and leader status must not be derivable by unauthenticated queries.
properties.assertion: forall query returning is_admin or leader_status: caller.bearer_token.is_valid == true

properties.text: Test data INSERT statements in debug.sql must remain commented out in production deployments.
properties.assertion: forall INSERT in debug.sql: statement.is_commented == true in production

properties.text: Container restart policy must include backoff delay to prevent crash-loop resource exhaustion.
properties.assertion: restart_policy.has_backoff == true OR restart_policy.max_retries < infinity

properties.text: Port 3000 binding should not expose service to all network interfaces without firewall or reverse proxy.
properties.assertion: port_binding == '127.0.0.1:3000:3000' OR external_firewall.filters(3000) == true

properties.text: Foreign key constraints must prevent orphan references in member_team_relations and team_leaders.
properties.assertion: forall mtr in member_team_relations: EXISTS(teams.id == mtr.team_id) AND forall tl in team_leaders: EXISTS(teams.id == tl.team_id)

properties.text: Each generation must have exactly one role mapping in generation_roles table.
properties.assertion: forall g in generations: COUNT(generation_roles WHERE generation == g) == 1

properties.text: All network traffic on port 3000 must pass through bearer token authentication middleware.
properties.assertion: forall route in express_app: route.middleware_chain.includes(auth_middleware) == true

properties.text: Application-to-database queries must use parameterized statements for all user-supplied input.
properties.assertion: forall db_query(user_input): query.binding_type == 'parameterized'

properties.text: .env file must not be world-readable and must contain valid non-default secrets.
properties.assertion: file_permissions('.env').world_readable == false AND env.API_AUTH_TOKEN != default_value

properties.text: Debug SQL queries must only be executed by authorized database administrators, not application code.
properties.assertion: forall execution(debug.sql): executor.role == 'admin' AND executor.is_authenticated == true

properties.text: .env file must exist at deployment time for container to start successfully.
properties.assertion: pre(docker_compose_up): file_exists('.env') == true

properties.text: NODE_ENV=production in docker-compose must override any conflicting .env value.
properties.assertion: post(env_load): process.env.NODE_ENV == 'production' regardless of .env content

properties.text: Production Docker image must contain only dist/ artifacts, no TypeScript source or devDependencies.
properties.assertion: forall file in production_image: file.path.startsWith('dist/') OR file.is_runtime_dependency

properties.text: After container restart, all environment variables must be reloaded from .env with overrides reapplied.
properties.assertion: post(container_restart): env_vars == load(.env).merge(docker_compose_env_overrides)

properties.text: All five member schema tables must exist for application to function correctly.
properties.assertion: EXISTS(member.members) AND EXISTS(member.teams) AND EXISTS(member.member_team_relations) AND EXISTS(member.team_leaders) AND EXISTS(member.generation_roles)
